title: The ‘Forever War’ in Afghanistan: 25 Years in Pictures
summary: From the first weeks after the Sept. 11 attacks to the chaotic U.S. withdrawal and return of the Taliban, The New York Times has documented a quarter-century of conflict and daily life in Afghanistan.
